46:2: Tarusi n Tezmamt sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ṣṣwab.
46:3: Ur Nexliq tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, siwa s tideţ, ar lajel iţwassnen. Wid ijehlen numren ayen uɣuṛ ţwanedṛen.
46:4: Ini: "day ur twalam ara wigi uɣuṛ la teţnujum, war Ṛebbi? Sseknet iyi d, d acu xelqen si tmurt, neɣ ma sɛan amur deg igenwan? Awit iyi d tazmamt id izwaren tagi, neɣ lateṛ n tmusni, ma tessawalem tideţ".
46:5: Anwa innetlafen sennig wid iţnujun, war Ṛebbi, ɣeṛ wayen ur asen d neţţarra, ar ass n tnekra, u nitni stehzan deg unuju nnsen?
46:6: Mara twafesrem imdanen, ad ilin d icenga nnsen, ad skiddben aɛbad nnsen.
46:7: Ma ɣṛan asen issekniyen nneɣ iberrzen, wid iugin tideţ, mi ten id tusa, ad inin: "wagi d ssḥur n ṣṣeḥ".
46:8: Neɣ ad inin: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "lemmer it id snulfaɣ, ur tezmirem ad iyi tsellkem, s wacemma, si Ṛebbi. Neţţa, Yif akw akken Issen, acu tḥekkum fellas. Iqadd Neţţa d Anagi gari yidwen. Neţţa, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
46:9: Ini: "ur lliɣ, ger imazanen, d win id isnulfuyen. Ur ẓṛiɣ acu ara iḍṛun yidi, neɣ yidwen. La ṭṭafaṛeɣ, kan, ayen iyi d iţţuweḥḥan. Aql i, kan, nek, d aneddaṛ iţbegginen".
46:10: Ini: "meyyzet ma, ayagi, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, u tnekṛem t? Icehhed unagi n At Isṛail, ɣef lmetl is, dɣa iumen. Tesmeɣwrem iman nnwen". Ih, Ṛebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
46:11: Nnan wid ijehlen, i wid iumnen: "lemmer d ayen ilhan, ur aɣ zeggwiren ɣuṛes". Imi ur ţwanhan ara syis, qqaṛen: "ayagi d tikerkas n zik".
46:12: Uqbel is, Tazmamt n Musa, d nnhaya u d aḥunu. Tagi d Tazmamt itebbiten, s wawalen n taɛṛabt, a ţţendeṛ wid idensen, a ţţessefṛeḥ lɛuṣam.
46:13: Ih, wid iqqaṛen: "Mass nneɣ d Ṛebbi, dɣa ṭfen degs, ur ţţagaden, ur ɣweblen".
46:14: Widak d at Loennet, degs ad wekkṛen, d arraz n wayen xeddmen.
46:15: Nweṣṣa amdan ar lewqama s imawlan is. Imma s temḥen s tadist, temḥen di tinnufra. Ger tadist akked ujumi, caret wagguren. Armi ibbweḍ d anqaqṛi, issaweḍ kuẓet isegwasen, inna: "a Mass iw! Eoo iyi a K snemmreɣ af lɣit i ɣ Tɣateḍ, nek akked lwaldin iw; ad xedmeɣ ayen ilhan ara K iṛaḍin. Efk iyi d tarwa ilhan. Aql i utubeɣ K, aql i seg imḍuɛen".
46:16: ɣuṛ wigi, Nqebbel lmefruz igiten nnsen, a Nessuref i tucmitin nnsen, ger at Loennet; d lemɛahda n tideţ, i sen iţţuwaɛɛden.
46:17: Win innan i imawlan is: "tfuh nnwen! Day yi tɛahdem a d kkreɣ? Niɣ ɛaddan isuta uqbel i". Nitni teţţren tacḍaṭ n Ṛebbi: "a ssexḍ ik, amen! Ih, lmɛahda n Ṛebbi, d tideţ". A d yini: "ayagi, siwa tiḥkayin imezwura".
46:18: D wigi iɣef iṣaṛ wawal iaɛnan leoyus n leonun akked yimdanen, i ten id izwaren. Ih, nitni d imexsuṛen.
46:19: I akw tiseddarin n wayen xedmen, iwakken ad yili warraz igiten nnsen. Nitni ur ţwadensen.
46:20: Ass ideg ara kecmen ar tmes, wid ijehlen: "tḍegɛam tiẓidanin i s tezham, di tmeddurt nnwen di ddunit. Assa, a ţţeţţuqeṭṭim s uɛaqeb isdullun, imi tessemɣwaṛem iman nnwen di tmurt, ur teklalem; imi tellam tbeɣwlem".
46:21: Mmekti d agmat n Ɛad, mi indeṛ agdud is deg igidan, u, s tideţ, ɛaddan d ineddaṛen zdat es, u zdeffir es: "siwa Ṛebbi ara tɛabdem. Nek ugadeɣ, fellawen, aɛaqeb n wass abarar".
46:22: Nnan d: "day aɣ d tusiḍ, ad aɣ tfaṛqeḍ akked iṛebbiten nneɣ? Awi aɣ d ayen iɣef la ɣ tessagwadeḍ, ma tessawaleḍ tideţ"!
46:23: Inna: "tamusni ar Ṛebbi kan. Ssawḍeɣ awen ayen iɣef id ţţuceggɛaɣ. Maca, walaɣ kwen d agdud ur nessin".
46:24: Mi t walan d asigna id ileḥḥun ar tɣwezza nnsen, nnan: "wagi d asigna ar aɣ d iawin ageffur". Xaṭi! D ayen iɣef tḥarem, d aḍu, degs aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan;
46:25: ad isqucc yal cci, s lameṛ n Mass is. Gwran d ur teţwaliḍ siwa ixxamen nnsen. Akka i Neţqeṭṭi igduden ibeɣwḍiyen.
46:26: Niɣ Nessakrer asen ayen ur awen Nessakrer. Nefka yasen imeẓẓuɣen, allen, akked wulawen. Ula i sen d bbwin deg wacemma imeẓẓuɣen, allen, akked wulawen, mi skaddben issekniyen n Ṛebbi. Ayen iɣef ttihin, izzi d fellasen.
46:27: Niɣ nessenger akw timdinin i wen d izzin, u Nenewwel asent issekniyen, amar a d uɣalent s abrid.
46:28: Acimi ur ten sellken ara wid rran d iṛebbiten iẓẓaẓan, war Ṛebbi? Xaṭi! Ooan ten. D ayagi ay d tikerkas nnsen, u d wayen id snulfuyen.
46:29: Mi k ed Nebbwi agraw n leonun, ad ssemḥessen i Leqwṛan; mi s ḥedṛen, nnan: "ḥesset"! Mi ifukk, uɣalen s agdud nnsen d ineddaṛen.
46:30: Nnan: "a yagdud nneɣ, aql aɣ nesla i Tezmamt id irsen, deffir Musa, id itebbten ayen iţ id izwaren, i inehhun ar tideţ akked ubrid uwqim.
46:31: A yagdud nneɣ, erret awal i uberraḥ n Ṛebbi, amnet yiS, ad awen Isemmeḥ seg ibekkaḍen nnwen, a kwen Isellek seg uɛaqeb aqeṛḥan".
46:32: Win isɛaweẓgen i uberraḥ n Ṛebbi, ur iţsellik di tmurt, ur iţţaf imawlan, war Neţţa. Widak di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ.
46:33: Day ur walan ara ar Ṛebbi d Win Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, ur Ifcil seg uxlaq nnsen? Izmer a d Issider lmeggtin. Ih, Neţţa Izmer i yal cci.
46:34: Ass ideg ara d rsen, ar tmes, wid ijehlen: "mačči s tideţ ayagi"? A d inin: "ih, s Mass nneɣ"! A d Yini: "jeṛṛbet aɛaqeb ɣef wayen la tnekṛem"!
46:35: Eṣbeṛ akken ṣebṛen wid iṛeṣmen seg imazanen. I nitni, ur ţɣawal. Ass ideg ara walin acu i sen iţţuwaɛɛden, amzun ur kminen siwa saɛa n wass. D aberreḥ: "anwa ara iţwakksen, siwa agdud icemten"?
47:1: Wid ijehlen, u ssefṛaɣen abrid n Ṛebbi, Itlef igiten nnsen.
47:2: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, umnen s wayen id irsen ar Muḥemmed, u neţţa d tideţ sɣuṛ Mass nnsen; Issemsa yasen tucmitin nnsen, Iṣeggem asen lḥala nnsen.
47:3: Ayagi, acku wid ijehlen ṭṭafaṛen tikerkas; ma d wid iumnen, ṭṭafaṛen tideţ n Mass nnsen. Akka id Iţţak Ṛebbi imedyaten nnsen i imdanen.
47:4: Mara d temlilem akked wid ijehlen, ewwtet ar tmegraḍ ar ten tɣelbem. Arzet ţen nezzeh. Sinna, d aserreḥ neɣ d feddu, alamma isers ṭṛad tiɛekkwmin is. Akka, lemmer i S ihwi i Ṛebbi, yili Iɣleb iten, maca a kwen Ijeṛṛeb, kra s kra. Wid iţwanɣan deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, ur ţṛuḥun igiten nnsen, d awezɣi.
47:5: A ten Inhu, ad Iṣeggem lḥala nnsen.
47:6: A ten Issekcem di Loennet i sen Imla.
47:7: A wid iumnen! Ma tefkam afus i Ṛebbi, ad awen Ifk afus, ad awen itebbet isurifen.
47:8: Wid ijehlen, ay amxix nnsen, ad weddṛen igiten nnsen.
47:9: Ayagi, acku ugwin ayen id Issers Ṛebbi; ihi, Imḥa igiten nnsen.
47:10: Aɛni ur nudan ara tamurt, ad walin amek teḍṛa d imezwura nnsen? Issexḍ iten Ṛebbi. Am akka i ijehliyen.
47:11: Ayagi, acku Ṛebbi d bab n wid iumnen. Ijehliyen, ur asen illi bab.
47:12: Ih, Ṛebbi ad Issekcem wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen. Wid ijehlen zehhun, teţţen akken iteţţ lmal. D times ay d leqṛaṛ nnsen.
47:13: Acḥal n at temdinin i yifen, di tezmert, tamdint i k id iẓɛan! Nesqucc iten, ur asen illi useṭṭaṛ.
47:14: Day win illan ar ubeggen n Mass is, am win, iwumi ţţucebbḥen yir igiten is, u iṭṭafaṛen chawi nnsen?
47:15: Amek tga Loennet i iţţuwaɛɛden i wid iţḥezziben: degs isaffen n waman ur nxeţţeṛ, isaffen n yiɣi ur tfessed lbenna s, isaffen n ccṛab aẓidan i wid itessen, isaffen n tament iţţuneqqan. Degs, i nitni, yal ţţemṛa, akked ssmaḥ n Mass nnsen. Day am wid iwekkṛen di tmes; sswan ten s waman iţţayzagen, ara icergen afwad nnsen?
47:16: Llan garasen wid i k issemḥasen. Sifat ffɣen d sɣuṛek, ad inin i wid iwumi teţţunefk tmusni: "d acu id inna kan, llinna"? Wigi d wid iwumi Isleɣ Ṛebbi ulawen, teddun kan d chawi nnsen.
47:17: Wid iţwanhan, Irna asen nnhaya, Ifka yasen aḥezzeb nnsen.
47:18: Day la ţṛaoun kan imir, a ten id ias, deqzalla? Niɣ usant ed licaṛat is. Ma iusa d ɣuṛsen, iwumi t usmekti nnsen?
47:19: Cfu ar, s tideţ, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Ṛebbi; ssuter ssmaḥ ubekkaḍ ik, akked wid n lmumnin, argaz tameṭṭut. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa anda tḥebkem, akked wanda tberrkem.
47:20: La qqaṛen wid iumnen: "a lemmer a d ters tsuṛeţ"! Maca, mi d ters tsuṛeţ tuḥkimt, ideg id iţwader umennuɣ, a ţwaliḍ at wul iblan, la k id ţmuqulen s tiṭ n win tessexcawat tmeţţant. Yif it i nitni
47:21: wannuz, akked wawal uwqim. Mi iţwagzem ṛṛay, ma ssawlen tideţ ar Ṛebbi yif it i nitni.
47:22: Day mačči, ma twexxṛem, ahat a ţţesfesdem tamurt, a ţfaṛqem alag nnwen?
47:23: Wigi d wid i Ixza Ṛebbi; Isgugem iten, Isderɣel iẓṛi nnsen.
47:24: Day ur ţmeyyizen ara Leqwṛan, neɣ uɣalent tsergal ɣef wulawen?
47:25: Ih, wid ixedɛan, deffir ubeggen n nnhaya ɣuṛsen, ikellex iten Cciṭan. Iooa ten tallit.
47:26: Ayagi, acku nitni nnan i wid iugin ayen d Issader Ṛebbi: "ad awen naɣ awal di kra n lumuṛ". Ṛebbi Iẓṛa lesrar nnsen.
47:27: Amek ihi, ma ddment lmalayek leṛwaḥ nnsen, la ten kkatent ar udmawen nnsen, iɛrar nnsen?
47:28: Akka, ihi, ddan akked wayen isserfayen Ṛebbi. Ugin llza S. Dɣa Isseṛxes igiten nnsen.
47:29: Neɣ ɣilen at wul amehzul, ard awezɣi, ur d Issuffuɣ ara Ṛebbi lebɣweḍ nnsen?
47:30: Lemmer i ɣ ihwi, ad ak ten id Nessken, war ccekk, a ten tɛaqleḍ ar udem nnsen, a ten tɛaqleḍ ar ṣṣenf umeslay. Ṛebbi Issen igiten nnwen.
47:31: S tideţ, a kwen Njeṛṛeb, alamma Nessen imjuhad, akked iṣebṛiyen, segwen. A Njeṛṛeb isallen nnwen.
47:32: Ih, wid ijehlen, issefṛaɣen abrid n Ṛebbi, i inuqmen Amazan, deffir ubeggen n nnhaya ɣuṛsen, ur ḍuṛṛen Ṛebbi s wacemma. Ad Isseṛxes igiten nnsen.
47:33: A wid iumnen! Aɣet awal i Ṛebbi, aɣet awal i Umazan, ur ssiṛxiset igiten nnwen!
47:34: Ih, wid ijehlen, issefṛaɣen abrid n Ṛebbi, sinna, mmuten d ijehliyen, war ccekk, ur sen Iţsemmiḥ Ṛebbi, d awezɣi.
47:35: Ur ţţiṛhifet, ur ssuturet tifrat, mara tilim d ineɣlaben! U Ṛebbi yidwen, ur kwen Iţḥewwio, d awezɣi, seg igiten nnwen.
47:36: Tameddurt di ddunit, d urar kan, akked lhawiyya. Ma tumnem u tḥezbem, ad awen d Ifk arrazen nnwen. Ur awen issutur ayla nnwen.
47:37: Ma Issuter awen t, a kwen Icebbwel, a ţcuḥḥem, a d iffeɣ lebɣweḍ nnwen.
47:38: D kunwi i iţwanecden a ţseddqem deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Llan degwen wid iţcuḥḥun. Win iţcuḥḥun, iţcuḥḥu kan ɣef yiman is. Ṛebbi d Asɛay, kunwi d igellilen. Ma twexxṛem, a kwen Ineṣṣef s ugdud ur nelli segwen. Dɣa ur ţţemcabin ɣuṛwen.
48:2: iwakken ad Isemmeḥ Ṛebbi ibekkaḍen ik id izwaren akked wid igwran. Ad ak Itim lɣit iS, a k Iawi d ubrid uwqim.
48:4: D Neţţa id Issersen talwit deg ulawen n lmumnin, iwakken ad yimɣuṛ liman nnsen. N Ṛebbi Iɛsekṛiwen n tmurt akked igenwan. Ṛebbi Izga Iẓẓeṛ, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
48:5: Iwakken ad Issekcem wid akked tid iumnen, ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, degsen ad wekkṛen. Ad asen Issemsu tucmitin nnsen. D wagi, ar Ṛebbi, ay d rrbeḥ abarar.
48:6: Ad Iɛaqeb ixabiten, tixabitin, imcurak, timcurak, wid id iţfekkiṛen Ṛebbi yir afekkeṛ. Izzi yasen ddens. Irfa Ṛebbi fellasen, Ixza ten. Ihegga yasen d Loahennama. A tuɣalin tucmiţ!
48:7: N Ṛebbi iɛsekṛiwen n tmurt akked igenwan. Ṛebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
48:8: Ih, Nuzen ik id d anagi, d abcir, d aneddaṛ,
48:9: iwakken a ţţamnem s Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, a T kfum, ad aS tanzem, a T tesbuccuɛem taṣebḥit, tameddit.
48:10: Wid iɛaqden yidek ɛaqden kan d Ṛebbi. Afus n Ṛebbi nnig ufus nnsen. Win iḥenten, d imanis kan i isseḥnet. Win iṭṭfen deg wayen iɣef iɛuhed Ṛebbi, ad as Ifk arraz abarar.
48:11: Ad ak inin wid igwran, seg uɛṛaben n ucluḥ: "i ɣ iceɣwlen, d ayla nneɣ akked twaculin nneɣ. Ssuter a neţţusemmeḥ". Qqaṛen s yilsawen nnsen, ayen ur nelli deg ulawen nnsen. Ini: "anwa ara kwen iselken si Ṛebbi, s wacemma, ma Ibɣa yawen ḍḍeṛṛ, neɣ ma Ibɣa yawen abaɣuṛ? Xaṭi, Izga Ṛebbi Iţţuxebbeṛ af wayen txeddmem.
48:12: Xaṭi, tɣilem Amazan akked lmumnin ur d ţţuɣalen ara, d awezɣi, ar twaculin nnsen. Ayagi, issefṛeḥ ulawen nnwen. Nnwaya nnwen dir iţ. Kunwi d agdud imsenger.
48:13: Wid ur numin s Ṛebbi, akked Umazan iS, ihi, aql aɣ Nhegga d ajajiḥ i ijehliyen.
48:14: N Ṛebbi, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Iţsemmiḥ i win i S ihwan, Iţɛuqub win i S ihwan. Ṛebbi Izga Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
48:15: A d inin wid igwran: "ma tṛuḥem a d tɣeltem, ooet aɣ a neddu yidwen". Bɣan ad bedlen awalen n Ṛebbi. Ini: "ur teţţeddum yidneɣ, d awezɣi. Akka ay d izwar wawal n Ṛebbi". A d inin: "teḥsedm aɣ"! Xaṭi, cwiṭ kan ay fehhmen.
48:16: Ini i wid igwran, seg uɛṛaben n ucluḥ: "a ţţeţwanecdem s agdud amaɛwaṛu, uqsiḥ; a t tennaɣem, neɣ ad anzen. Ma tuɣem awal, ad awen Ifk Ṛebbi arraz igerzen. Ma twexxṛem, akken twexxṛem uqbel, a kwen Iɛaqeb s lqeṛḥ".
48:17: Ur telli tiyta deg uderɣal, neɣ deg urejdal, neɣ deg umuḍin. Win iunzen i Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, a t Issekcem di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen. Win iwexxṛen, a t Iɛaqeb s lqeṛḥ.
48:18: Niɣ Iṛuḍa Ṛebbi lmumnin, mi ɛaqden yidek, seddaw ttejṛa. Iẓṛa i illan deg ulawen nnsen, Issers d fellasen talwit, Iɣna ten s lɣelb aqṛib,
48:19: akked waṭas n lerbaḥ, ara ṭṭfen. Ṛebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
48:20: Iwaɛɛed awen Ṛebbi a d teṭṭfem lerbaḥ aṭas. Iɣawel awen d deg waya. Ikkes fellawen afus n medden. Akken ad yili ussekni i lmumnin, a kwen iawi d ubrid uwqim.
48:21: Tayeḍ, iwumi ur tezmirem, ihi, Izzi as Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi Izga Izmer i yal cci.
48:22: Lemmer i kwen nnuɣen wid ijehlen, ad rewlen, sinna, ur ţţafen bab, neɣ asettaṛ.
48:23: D tannumi n Ṛebbi i illan si zik. Ur teţţafeḍ abeddel, d awezɣi, di tannumi n Ṛebbi.
48:24: D Neţţa i Ikksen afus nnsen segwen, akked ufus nnwen segsen, di teɣzut n Mekka, siweḍ Issɣelb ikwen fellasen. Ṛebbi Izga Iţwali ayen txeddmem.
48:25: D nitni i ijehlen. Swexxṛen kwen si Loamaɛ n Lḥaṛam, ugin ad iaweḍ usfel s amkan is. Lemmer mačči d lmumnin, argaz tameṭṭut, ur ten tessinem, a ten tḥazem ur teẓṛim; segsen a d tegwrim di leɣṛuṛ - niɣ Ṛebbi Issekcam s aḥunu S, win i S ihwan - lemmer mfaṛaqen, yili, war ccekk, Nesɛadda, ɣef wid segsen ijehlen, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
48:26: Mi rran wid ijehlen, aḥernun deg ulawen nnsen, aḥernun n war tussna, Issers ed Ṛebbi talwit iS af Umazan iS, akked lmumnin. Iqqen asen awal uḥezzeb. Iwata ten, klalen t. Ṛebbi Izga Iẓṛa yal cci.
48:27: Niɣ Issaweḍ Ṛebbi, i Umazan iS, tamuɣli s tideţ: war ccekk, a ţkecmem Loamaɛ n Lḥaṛam, ma Irad Ṛebbi, di laman, iqweṛṛa nnwen ṣṣeṭlen u qeṛcen, ur teţţagwadem. Iẓṛa ayen ur teẓṛim. Ihegga yawen d, ugwar aya, lɣelb aqṛib.
48:28: Neţţa id Iuznen Amazan iS s nnhaya, akked ddin n tideţ, iwakken a t Issifrer ɣef ddin meṛṛa. Iqadd Ṛebbi d Anagi.
48:29: Muḥemmed d Amazan n Ṛebbi. Wid illan yides, qesḥen ar ijehliyen, ḥninit garasen. A ten twaliḍ ṭṭinizen, kennun, ssuturen lfeḍl sɣuṛ Ṛebbi akked llza. Ccama nnsen, deg udmawen nnsen, d lateṛ n lekni. Ata wayen i ten icban di Tuṛa akked wayen i ten icban di Linoil: am uɛaqqa, iger ed imɣi s, isoehd it. Ad iuzur, ad iɛaooeṛ ɣef yileɣ is. Iţţaɛoab ifellaḥen; iɣwebben yissen ijehliyen. Iwaɛɛed Ṛebbi ssmaḥ akked warraz abarar, i wid degsen iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan.
49:1: A wid iumnen! Ur zeggwiret zdat Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Issel, d Amusnaw.
49:2: A wid iumnen! Ur zzuhriyet tuɣac nnwen, sennig taɣwect n Nnbi. Ur zaɛɛḍet ɣuṛes, akken teţzaɛɛḍam garawen, mulac ad mḥun igiten nnwen, kunwi ur tfaqem.
49:3: Ih, wid issrusun ṣut n taɣwect nnsen, ar Umazan n Ṛebbi, d wid iwumi Issefsi Ṛebbi ulawen nnsen, ar uḥezzeb. Ad asen iţţunefk ssmaḥ akked warraz abarar.
49:4: Ih, tegwti n wid ik n issawlen, deffir texxamin, ur ţmeyyizen.
49:5: Lemmer ṣbiṛen ard teffɣeḍ ɣuṛsen, ţţif i nitni. Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
49:6: A wid iumnen! Aballaɣ ma ibbwi yawen d asali, ţţuḥeqqeqet, mulac a ţḍuṛṛem agdud, war tamusni, a ţţuɣalem tnedmem deg wayen txedmem.
49:7: Cfut illa garawen Umazan n Ṛebbi. Ma issemḥes awen deg waṭas n lumuṛ, a ţjafem. Maca, Ṛebbi Issaɛzez awen liman, Imelleḥ it deg ulawen nnwen, Isseṛẓeg awen tijehli, ddɣel, lmaɛṣegga. Widak d wid iţwanhan.
49:8: D lfeḍl sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, d lɣit. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
49:9: Ma nnuɣent snat n ṭayfat n lmumnin, ḥuddet ţent. Ma tebwɣeḍ yiwet degsent, ɣef tayeḍ, nnaɣet tin ibweɣḍen alamma teḍfeṛ lameṛ n Ṛebbi. Ma teḍfeṛ it, ssemṣalḥet ţent, s lmizan. Wezznet. Ṛebbi Iḥemmel wid iwezznen.
49:10: Lmumnin d atmaten kan i illan. Ssemṣalḥet atmaten nnwen, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, amar fellawen aḥunu.
49:11: A wid iumnen! ɣuṛwat ad imaɛlek ugdud ɣef wayeḍ, ahat d widen i ten yifen. Neɣ tilawin ɣef tiyaḍ, ahat d tiden i tent yifen. Ur ţqeṛṛidet iman nnwen, ur ţmirgamet s tselleqwbin. Dir it isem n ddɣel, anda illa liman. Wid ur nutub ara, d widak ay d imednas.
49:12: A wid iumnen! Janbet aṭas n nnwaya. Ih, nnwaya, tikwal, d abekkaḍ. Ur ţţemɛassat ara. Ur kkatet wa deg wa. Day ibɣu yiwen, degwen, ad ičč aksum n gmas lmegget? A t tagwim. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi Issuruf, Iţḥunu.
49:13: A yimdanen! Niɣ Nxelq ikwen si ddker akked nnta. Nerra kwen d igduden, d laɛṛac, a ţţemyussanem. Ihi, ukyis nnwen amxallef, ar Ṛebbi, d win degwen iţḥezziben sennig wiyaḍ. Ih, Ṛebbi Iẓṛa, Iţţuxebbeṛ.
49:14: Nnan uɛṛaben n ucluḥ: "numen". Ini: "ur tuminem". Maca init ed: "nunez"; ur ikcim ara liman ar wulawen nnwen. Ma tṛuḍam Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, ur awen Isṛuḥu acemma seg igiten nnwen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
49:15: Lmumnin d wid kan iumnen s Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, dɣa, ur ţcukun. Pnaɣen s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen, deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. D widak ay d imawlan n tideţ.
49:16: Ini: "day ad aS temlem i Ṛebbi, ddin nnwen"? Ṛebbi Iẓṛa i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ṛebbi Issen yal cci.
49:17: Rran ak annuz nnsen, d tajmilt. Ini: "ur iyi telli tejmilt deg annuz nnwen. Xaṭi, d Ṛebbi ikwen Iɣaten mi kwen Inha ar liman, ma d imawlan n tideţ ay tellam".
49:18: Ih, Ṛebbi Issen tabaḍnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Ṛebbi Iţwali ayen txeddmem.
50:2: Xaṭi! Wehmen mi ten id iusa uneddaṛ, segsen. Nnan ijehliyen: "ayagi d lwehma!
50:3: Ma nemmut, nuɣal d akal, ayagi d tuɣalin si mbɛid"!
50:4: Niɣ Neẓṛa acḥal, segsen, i issenqes wakal. ɣuṛneɣ Tazmamt iḥerrzen.
50:5: Xaṭi! Nekṛen tideţ, mi ten id tusa, dɣa terwi lḥala nnsen.
50:6: Day ur muqlen ara igenni, sennig sen, amek i t Nebna? Ncebbeḥ it, ur isɛi iɣisan.
50:7: Tamurt, Nḍelq iţ, Nerra degs idurar, Nessemɣi d degs tayuga n yal ṣṣenf amxallef,
50:8: i tmuɣli akked usmekti n yal amdan isteṛoiɛen.
50:9: Nesseɣli d seg igenni aman iṛqan. Nessemɣi d yissen leonanat akked uɛqqa n tmegra,
50:11: d ṛṛeẓq i imdanen. Nessider d yissen tamurt immuten. Akka tanekra.
50:12: Inkeṛ, uqbel nnsen, ugdud n Nuḥ, At Rrass, Tamud,
50:14: At Laika, akked ugdud n Tubbaɛ. Nekṛen akw imazanen. Iṣaṛ ussigwed iW.
50:15: Day ɣ issefcel uxlaq amezwaru? Wanag nitni di ccekk ɣef uxlaq amaynut.
50:16: Niɣ Nxelq ed amdan. Neẓṛa s wacu i t tɣewwu, teṛwiḥt is. Neqṛeb ɣuṛes, sennig iẓuṛan n temgaṛt is.
50:17: Mara ṭṭfen wid iţţaṭṭafen; qqimen, wa ɣeṛ yeffus, wa ɣeṛ zelmeḍ,
50:18: ur d iqqaṛ awal, siwa ma illa ɣuṛes, uɛssas imḥelles.
50:19: Iusa d ddux n tmeţţant, ibbwi d tideţ: "atan wayen iseg la treggwleḍ".
50:20: Aṣuḍu di lbuq. D wagi ay d ass n ussigwed.
50:21: Yal iman a d ias s unehhaṛ, akked unagi.
50:22: Niɣ telliḍ testehzaḍ ɣef waya. Nekkes ak taduli k. Iẓṛi k, assa, d uzzal.
50:23: Ad yini umsaɛef is: "ata ɣuṛi wayen id iţţuheggan".
50:26: i irran ar tama n Ṛebbi, ṛebbi nniḍen. Ihi, ḍeggṛet eţ s aɛaqeb uqsiḥ!
50:27: A d yini umsaɛef is: "a Mass nneɣ! Ur t rriɣ d amjuṛ, d neţţa i illan di ttelfan uɣmiq".
50:28: Inna: "ur ţţemnamaret ara ɣuṛI, imi wen d Zzewreɣ aɛggen.
50:29: Ur iţbeddil ɣuṛI wawal. Nek, ur Ṭṭuṛṛuɣ imdanen".
50:30: Ass ideg ara Nini i Loahennama: "ma teččuṛeḍ"? A d tini: "ma tella tmerna"?
50:31: Tqeṛb ed Loennet, ar wid iţḥezziben, ur tebɛad.
50:32: "D tagi i wen iţţuwaɛɛden; i yal atubi iḥerzen,
50:33: iţţagwaden Aḥnin di tbaḍnit, iteddun s wul ucɛif.
50:34: Ekcemt eţ, di tifrat, d wagi ay d ass uwekkeṛ"!
50:35: Nnsen, dinna, ayen i sen ihwan; sɣuṛneɣ, timerna.
50:36: Acḥal isuta ay Nesqucc uqbel nnsen! Llan ɣelben ten di loehd. Qelben, di tmurt, anda t ssṛan?
50:37: Deg waya, s tideţ, asmekti i win isɛan ul, neɣ ifkan tameẓẓuɣt, u d anagi.
50:38: Niɣ Nxelq ed tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, di sdis wussan, ur Naɛyi.
50:39: Eṣbeṛ i wayen d qqaṛen, sbuccaɛ s ccekṛan Mass ik, uqbel ad inqeṛ yiṭij, uqbel ad iɣli.
50:40: Deg iḍ sbuccaɛ iT, akked deffir lekni.
50:41: Ssemḥes, ass ideg ara d iberreḥ uberraḥ, si tama iqeṛben.
50:42: Ass ideg ara slen i usuɣu, s tideţ, ass nni, d ass n tuffɣa.
50:43: Ih, Nekwni Nessidir u Nneqq. ɣuṛneɣ tuɣalin.
50:44: Ass ideg ara tceqqeq tmurt ɣuṛsen s tazla. Afesser agi d ayen isehlen fellaneɣ.
50:45: Nekwni Nif akw akken Neẓṛa acu id qqaṛen. Ur telliḍ fellasen d aqehhaṛ. Mmekti d, s Leqwṛan, wid iţţagwaden aɛggen iW.
51:5: Ar ayen i wen iţţuɛahden, d tideţ.
51:15: Ih, wid iţḥezziben, di leonanat akked tliwa;
51:16: Ṭṭfen ayen i sen Ifka Mass nnsen. Ih, nitni llan, iuɣ lḥal, d lɛuṣam.
51:19: deg wayla nnsen: amur i umaţţar akked umeɣbun.
51:20: U di tmurt, issekniyen i wid iţţutebbten.
51:21: Llant deg iman nnwen. Aɛni ur teţwalim ara?
51:22: U deg igenni, ṛṛeẓq nnwen, akked wayen i wen iţţuwaɛɛden.
51:23: S Mass n tmurt akked igenwan, ar neţţa d tideţ, am akken kunwi teţmeslayem!
51:24: Ma tebbweḍ ik id tedyant inebgawen ukyisen n Ibṛahim?
51:25: Kecmen ɣuṛes, nnan as: "tifrat"! Inna: "tifrat a wid ur nessin!"
51:26: Inser ar twacult is, ibbwi d aɛjmi iqebbwan.
51:27: Iqeṛb asen t id; inna: "day ur teţţeţţem ara"?
51:28: Iḥus iugad iten. Nnan as: "ur ţţagwad"! Dɣa beccṛen t s uqcic amusnaw
51:29: Tqeṛb ed tmeṭṭut is, tsuɣ, tewwet deg udem is, tenna d: "tamɣaṛt tiɛiqeṛt?"
51:30: Nnan: "akka id Inna Mass im. Ih, Neţţa, d Bab n ṣṣwab, d Amusnaw".
